title: TN-ready hydrology, water-age and bankfull hydraulic-exposure interface

reach_products.daily: One row per date and Reach
reach_products.monthly: One row per calendar month and Reach, preserving mean discharge and integrated water volumes
minimum_fields: routed total, fast, slow and direct discharge
integrated total, fast, slow and direct volume
modeled routed water-age moment and mean age where defined
forcing-source flag and air temperature as a covariate, not water temperature
storage, controlled release, spill and total release
fast, slow and direct source masses/fractions
storage/release age moments and mean ages
water, source-tracer and age-moment closure errors

channel_geometry.source: Andreadis et al. 2025 bankfull width and depth matched to Reach

hydraulic_exposure.zero_flow_semantics: Set exposure to null and emit a zero-flow flag; do not insert an arbitrary discharge floor
hydraulic_exposure.claim_boundary: Geometry-and-flow exposure proxy, not tracer-validated residence time; P05/P95 are geometry sensitivity bounds, not a joint hydraulic confidence interval

tn_boundary.state_consistency: TN may later be coupled to the exported fast/slow stocks and fluxes without re-splitting total flow
